change: Chapter 15 §1.1 confirms coordination is a non-headed syntactic category, and a mixed NP/PP-coordination cannot be categorised as either a simple NP or a simple PP; labels reflect coordinate categories.

Chapter 15 §1.1 describes coordinates of equal status, usually but not necessarily linked by a coordinator; replacement of the whole by one coordinate and coordinate order reversal are diagnostics that normally, not invariably, work. The p. 1275 footnote gives joint coordination as a counterexample to independent replacement; its detailed analysis is deferred to §1.3.2.
